title: AI Feynman: Physics-Inspired Neuro-Symbolic Regression Rediscovers All 100 Equations from the Feynman Lectures
aiSystem: AI Feynman (Neural Network + Recursive Physics-Symmetry Symbolic Regression, MIT)
whyItMatters: Published in Science Advances, MIT’s neuro-symbolic AI Feynman paired neural fitting with dimensional analysis and symmetry detection to rediscover 100/100 equations from the Feynman Lectures on Physics from raw data.
summary: Published in Science Advances on April 15, 2020, Silviu-Marian Udrescu and Max Tegmark at MIT introduced AI Feynman, a recursive neuro-symbolic regression system designed to discover exact, human-readable mathematical laws directly from empirical data. Rather than relying purely on black-box curve fitting or brute-force expression trees, AI Feynman trains neural networks to detect translational symmetry, scale invariance, separability, and compositionality, recursively simplifying NP-hard symbolic search alongside dimensional analysis. Tested on 100 equations from the Feynman Lectures on Physics, AI Feynman solved 100% (versus 71% for prior commercial software Eureqa) and boosted accuracy on harder physics mysteries from 15% to 90%.
technicalHighlights: Paired neural-network symmetry/separability discovery with recursive symbolic search and dimensional analysis.
Rediscovered 100/100 equations from the Feynman Lectures on Physics from numerical tables alone (vs. 71% for Eureqa).
Improved symbolic recovery on a harder nonlinear physics benchmark from 15% to 90%, catalyzing modern symbolic regression benchmarks.
caveats: Benchmark milestone focused on rediscovering known textbook physics equations from clean or mildly noisy synthetic data rather than discovering a previously unknown fundamental law of nature.

scoreRationale.foundational: Established a foundational neuro-symbolic architecture showing how neural representations can unlock tractable exact symbolic law discovery.
scoreRationale.ripple: Widely cited across AI-for-physics, creating the standard Feynman symbolic regression benchmark and inspiring subsequent scientific equation-discovery agents.
scoreRationale.verification: Peer-reviewed in Science Advances (6:eaay2631) with open-source code and reproducible 100-equation benchmark.
scoreRationale.velocity: Automated exact equation extraction in minutes on problems intractable for pure brute-force search.
